variant.object_constructor: Exact source pg_class/pg_namespace/pg_proc/default_acl and exploded ACL field schemas bind full object identity, owner, schema usage, grants and verified body/effect inputs wherever the selected predicate requires them.
variant.default_constructor: One exact SCHEMA_DEFAULT model: global (creator O,namespace0,kind FUNCTION) explicit empty ACL, owner implicit rights retained; schema (O,N!=0,FUNCTION) ABSENT before and full grant row after. Future function creation F_NEW is by O in N, with complete source pg_proc fields/body/effect binding and schema usage; F_NEW is outside fixed source allowlist. No current-object ACL changes and no existing grant inferred from a future default.
variant.source_effects: Closed A4.2 source capability/ACL model only; observed source/ACL data cannot mint active Reader authority. Negative paths are authority-claim attempts, not grants or successful SQL executions.
